1879060636.name: Protection by the Sword
1879060636.desc: You enhance a target's ability to parry attacks, and when they parry or partially parry a blow, you gain a parry response.

1879094940.name: Call to Greatness
1879094940.desc:
You call out to your fellows, inspiring them to Greatness and resetting the cooldown of key skills. This is a raid-wide effect.

Beorning: Thickened Hide, Call to Wild, and Nature's Bond

Brawler: Come At Me and Battle Fury

Burglar: All In, Knives Out, and Trickster

Captain: Shield of the Dúnedain, Oathbreaker's Shame, and At the Fore

Champion: Unbreakable, Champion's Duel, and Great Cleave

Guardian: Juggernaut, Hammer Down, and Cataclysmic Shout

Hunter: Rapid Fire, Burn Hot, and Horn of Oromë

Lore-master: Murder of Crows, Nature's Fury, and Ancient Master

Mariner: The Breaking of Thangorodrim, Fore with Haste, and Steady Traveller

Minstrel: Legend of Helm Hammerhand and Cry of the Wizards

Rune-keeper: Essay of Exaltation, Combustion, and Concession and Rebuttal

Warden: For the Free Peoples, Recklessness, and Javelin of Deadly Force

<rgb=#00FFDD>You may only receive this effect once every 2 minutes.</rgb>

1879097884.name: I See You!
1879097884.desc: Your sight is so keen that you can keep a close eye on an enemy and never lose sight of them.

1879110172.name: Tale of the Elements' Battle
1879110172.desc: This aura increases the Vitality, Tactical Mitigation and Resistance of your Fellowship.

1879115164.name: Champion's Command
1879115164.desc: Greatly increases the target's damage and combat speed. Amarthiel's command stirs the target to great feats in battle.

1879115292.name: Blood of the Eldar
1879115292.desc: Even as the Elves fade into the West, there is still great power in the Elven bloodline. This skill restores morale.

1879134364.name: Fist and Shield
1879134364.desc: Mastery over the Fist: Allows Warden to perform Fist Gambits quickly.

1879136796.name: In Your Face
1879136796.desc: A quick double attack at close range.

1879139740.name: Paralytic Venom
1879139740.desc: You spit a neurotoxic venom, which paralyzes a target for a short duration.

1879205916.name: Galadhrim Horse
1879205916.desc: The Galadhrim have chosen to honour you with one of their prized horses.

1879209884.name: Steed of the Lore-master
1879209884.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the lore-master.

1879230620.name: Muscle Tear
1879230620.desc: You sink your teeth in and rip, slowing your targets attacks and movement.

1879231260.name: Javelin and Shield
1879231260.desc: Mastery over the Javelin: Allows Warden to perform Javelin Gambits quickly.

1879232412.name: Shield Mastery
1879232412.desc: Masterful shield movements increase your defences.

1879241628.name: Ballad - Dirge
1879241628.desc: Through the use of a dirge one can speak of the past glories of a fallen warrior and drain the very heart out of an enemy.

1879244572.name: Ranged Restoration
1879244572.desc: A masterful skill which applies a powerful heal-over-time effect.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879245852.name: War-steed: Medium
1879245852.desc: The Rouncey is a moderately armoured War-steed. The Rouncey provides balance and stability without sacrificing or favouring survivability or manoeuvrability.

1879246492.name: Improved Sweeping Cut
1879246492.desc: Large sweeping strokes cut into all of your foes standing before you causing them to bleed.

1879260060.name: Bard's Arrow
1879260060.desc: A shot that strikes the enemy with fear.

1879266844.name: Dúnadan's Strike
1879266844.desc: A Ranger is both master of blade and bow. This attack will stun the opponent.

1879269660.name: Stun Dust
1879269660.desc: Stunning the enemy by blowing dust in its face.

1879270300.name: Assailment - Stance
1879270300.desc:
Adjusts stance to attack from afar.

All Spear generating gambits and gambit masteries now generate a Javelin icon.

All spear gambits now require a javelin instead of a spear, and several gambits become ranged.

(Only one Stance may be active at a time.)

1879311260.name: Ferocious Roar
1879311260.desc: Let out a battle cry, causing you to rapidly gain Wrath.

1879318300.name: Thickened Hide
1879318300.desc: Drastically reduce damage taken for a duration. During this time, being struck will heal you for a percentage of your max Morale.

1879326492.name: Light Brown Goat
1879326492.desc: Summons a goat to keep you company.

1879338652.name: Steed of the Gloaming Autumn
1879338652.desc: A horse from the Fall Festival.

1879341724.name: Steed of the Eldar
1879341724.desc: A steed worthy of the Eldar.

1879366940.name: Elk of Felegoth's Glory
1879366940.desc: A mighty Lasgalen elk, garbed in celebration of Felegoth.

1879411740.name: Mountaineering Donkey
1879411740.desc: Summons a loveable and hard-working mountain donkey.

1879416220.name: Red Gecko
1879416220.desc: Summons a lizard to keep you company.

1879420316.name: Share Innate Strength: Heavy
1879420316.desc:
Bolster your fellowship and raid members with a portion of your Innate Strength: Heavy.
<rgb=#FF0000>Requires a Tier 4 Innate Strength: Heavy buff to be present on the Brawler.</rgb>

<rgb=#00FF00>If Specialized as The Fulcrum, all Fellowship and Raid Members within 15m gain: 
Increased Physical and Tactical Mitigation

If specialized as The Maelstrom, all Fellowship and Raid Members within 15m gain:
Increased Critical Rating</rgb>

1879422492.name: Drake's Bane Crossbow
1879422492.desc: Use this crossbow to shoot down flying drakes!

1879427868.name: Right Slice
1879427868.desc: To hear Glúrkub tell it, his foes always underestimate the speed of his right-handed slice.

1879457564.name: Desperate Fist
1879457564.desc: In a desperate fury, your cry resonates above the din of battle, forcing nearby enemies to focus on you for a brief time.

1879466268.name: Sail to Sûri-kylä
1879466268.desc: Navigate to Sûri-kylä with nearby fellows.

1879467804.name: Final Strike
1879467804.desc: Consuming all of your Wrath, you put all your energy into one devastating area attack to defeat up to 5 enemies before you.

1879485340.name: Heather Hamster
1879485340.desc: Summons an adorable hamster to keep you company.

1879488028.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Savannah Stalker)
1879488028.desc: Summons a big cat companion.\n\nThe cat is capable of attacking multiple foes at once.

1879490716.name: Shadow Nether-hound
1879490716.desc: Summons a shadowy hound to accompany you on your travels.

1879501340.name: Return to Utug-bûr
1879501340.desc: You're able to quickly return to the Temple of Utug-bûr, in the far reaches of Urash Dâr in the Ikorbân Valley. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879508636.name: Dark Grodbog Queen
1879508636.desc: Summons a temperamental grodbog queen to accompany you on your adventures.

1879521308.name: Vibrant Spotted Boglurker
1879521308.desc: Summons a vibrant spotted boglurker to accompany you on your adventures.

1879522076.name: Viznak's Cure?
1879522076.desc: Summon what Viznak assumes will be a way to stop the blight.
